text_block_list.text:
I stopped by a shrine with Win Variation, 
who hasn't been feeling well lately, for a 
change of pace—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
This shrine was actually used as a filming 
location for a movie I like.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Don't Stop Our Wind"... It's a passionate 
coming-of-age story about high schoolers 
pouring their hearts into track and field.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, 'cause it's a sacred ground, y'know? 
I was so moved I bawled my eyes out at the 
theater.

I totally get ya! It really is such a 
great movie~!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Bamboo-san. You like that movie too, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right! I come to this shrine from time to 
time. And then I just soak in all that 
thrill and excitement~

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Especially that summer training camp! The 
whole team encouraging one another to push 
through that grueling, intense training! 
Ahh, memories!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean! That single-minded 
determination really hits you in the 
heart, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
At the end of camp, seeing everyone shout 
their dreams out loud! That really fired 
me up, su!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I know! Why don't we try doing that movie 
scene, too? You know, the team rallying 
hype chant!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it! Fired up at the holy 
shrine... this is the best!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
How about you too, Trainer? It'll 
definitely get you fired up!

There are no other visitors around. It 
shouldn't be a problem if I brace myself 
and get serious alongside her.
choice_data_list: Alright, I'll give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
After we shout our goals, everyone puts 
their hands together and thrusts them up! 
Alright, I'll go first—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna have the most fiercely exciting 
races with all my rivals!!
choice_data_list: I'll make Sion's dream come true!
I will make Shion's dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm--I will become the main character!

text_block_list.name: Shion & Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Ready, and... Fight, OHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I'm all fired up! Feels like I 
can overcome any adversity now!

"Perhaps remembering the excitement of the 
movie, Win Variation was able to get back 
into top form."

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, ladies. I was just about to start 
cleaning up around here.

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
We're bringing in heavy machinery, so it's 
a bit dangerous. We'll have to keep the 
shrine grounds off-limits. I'm sorry, but 
please come back and relax another time.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry, sir! Seems like it'd be 
better to try another day, sir.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's save it for next time...

Perhaps it wasn't much of a change of 
pace; Win Variation didn't seem able to 
get back into top form.
